reports.stext: 智利铜月报：Codelco产量持平，全国同比-15%，El Teniente重回焦点 J.P. MORGAN · 铜 · 智利月度产量 智利9月铜矿产量：Codelco持平、全国同比-15%，El Teniente重回焦点 Global Copper: Cochilco Chile monthly mine production — Codelco production flat despite national output -15% YoY, El Teniente back in focus into October 机构： J.P. Morgan（Europe Equity Research） | 日期： 2026-11-13 | 页数： 15 | 团队： Patrick Jones（欧洲金属与矿业）、Lyndon Fagan（澳洲）、Rodolfo Angele（拉美）、Bill Peterson（北美）等 | 个股观点： Antofagasta（ANTO.L）OW、Lundin Mining（LUN.TO）UW 本页为第三方研报的中文精读摘要，仅供研究参考，不构成投资建议；全部观点与数据归属原机构（J.P. Morgan）。 目录 Contents 核心观点 KEY POINTS 全国产量：天气扰动后修复，同比仍-15% Codelco：进度仅63%，扰动不断 BHP/Rio、Teck 与 Lundin：Escondida反弹、QB2与Caserones疲弱 Antofagasta：四矿平稳，进度约70% SX-EW 与硫酸市场 Key Points 核心观点 KEY POINTS 全国产量修复但仍深跌： 智利9月铜产量 385kt ，环比 +5.1% 、同比 -15% ，主要矿山正从7月下旬-8月严重天气扰动中逐步恢复。 Codelco 进度落后： 9月自有矿产量 91.6kt（环比仅-1.3kt）；1-9月累计 853kt，仅完成全年 1.34Mt 官方目标的约 63% （隐含年化约 1.14Mt）。董事长最新表态 2026 年产量约 1.2Mt ，低于官方指引逾 100kt。 运营扰动不断： El Teniente 露天矿因滑坡临时停产、10月数据成为焦点；Andina 尾矿输送系统阻塞致选矿厂上周停运。 Escondida 反弹： 9月产量回升至 93.8kt （8月 76.1kt），FY27 指引 1,000-1,100kt（因品位下降低于 FY26 指引）；7-9月累计完成约25%，与 BHP FY27 目标 1,050kt 中值进度相符。 Lundin 再度下调： Caserones 9月仅 8.3kt，仍比正常 12-13kt/月的水平低约30%；Q3 财报中 Lundin 将 Caserones FY26 指引再砍 15kt 至 105-115kt 。QB2 9月降 3.3kt 至 11.6kt。 Antofagasta 平稳（OW）： 四座矿山环比全部稳定，1-9月产量 446kt，约为修正后全年指引中值（~640kt）的 70%。 SX-EW 不受硫酸影响： 月产约 90kt、占全国约 23%；据报道中国硫酸价格已从7月峰值 2,107 元/吨回落至约 1,484 元/吨（$222.5/t） 。 Section 01 全国产量：天气扰动后修复，同比仍-15% Chile total output: recovering from July-August weather disruption Cochilco 公布的9月数据显示，智利全国铜产量 385.1kt ，环比 +5.1%（8月为 366.3kt，为年内低点），但同比仍大幅 -15% 。7月下旬至8月的严重天气扰动是主因，9月各主要矿山环比普遍改善。分矿山看：Escondida 回升至 93.8kt、Collahuasi 30.7kt（环比+4kt）、Los Pelambres 26.8kt；而 Teck 旗下矿山环比走弱——QB2 降至 11.6kt（-3.3kt）、Caserones 8.3kt（虽较8月的 2.2kt 低位回升，但仍远低于常态）；Mantoverde 大幅降至 4.4kt。 图 1 · Cochilco 分矿山月度铜产量表（kt）：9月全国合计 385.1kt，环比 +5.1% | Table 1: Cochilco monthly copper production data by mine — Source: Cochilco（原文 p2） 要点： 9月环比修复主要来自 Escondida（+17.7kt）与 Codelco 系矿山；全国 1-9月累计 4,092kt，同比缺口显著。Teck 在 Q3 财报中仍维持全年产量指引不变。 Section 02 Codelco：进度仅63%，El Teniente 与 Andina 扰动不断 Codelco: 9M'26 at ~63% of the 1.34Mt target Codelco 9月自有矿产量 91.6kt ，环比仅下降 1.3kt，多数矿山环比改善；减量主要来自 Radomiro Tomic（约-4kt）与 Ministro Hales（约-4kt）。1-9月累计 853kt，仅完成 1.34Mt 年度目标的约 63% ，隐含年化运行水平约 1.14Mt ——即使按董事长表态的 ~1.2Mt 计算，仍比官方指引低逾 100kt。 扰动事件密集：El Teniente 9月产量 +2kt 至 23.7kt，但其露天矿此前期因滑坡临时停产， 10月数据成为焦点 ；上周 Codelco 又因尾矿输送系统阻塞暂停了 Andina 选矿厂，尽管公司称运营"可控"。分矿看，El Teniente 9月约 23.7kt 处于近五年同期偏低水平，Chuqui/RT/MH 合计仍是产量基本盘。 图 2 · Codelco 2026年自有矿累计产量（kt）：9月累计853kt vs 1.34Mt目标（红虚线） | Figure 1: Reported Codelco 2026 own mine copper production target at 1.34Mt — Source: Cochilco, company data（原文 p2） 图 3 · Codelco 月度产量跟踪（kt，2021-2026）：9月91.6kt，环比基本持平 | Figure 23: Codelco monthly copper production tracker — Source: Cochilco（原文 p9） 图 4 · El Teniente 月度产量跟踪（kt）：滑坡致露天矿临时停产，10月数据是焦点 | Figure 24: El Teniente (Codelco) monthly copper production tracker — Source: Cochilco（原文 p9） Section 03 BHP/Rio、Teck 与 Lundin：Escondida反弹、QB2与Caserones疲弱 Escondida rebounds; another Lundin guidance cut Escondida（BHP 57.5% / Rio 30%） 9月产量回升至 93.8kt （8月仅 76.1kt）；FY27 指引定为 1,000-1,100kt ，因品位下降而低于 FY26 指引。7-9月累计完成约 25%，进度与 BHP FY27 目标 1,050kt 中值相符。 Teck 系： QB2（Teck 60% / Codelco 10%）9月产量下降 3.3kt 至 11.6kt ；Andacollo 恢复至 7月水平（2.6kt）。 Lundin 系： Caserones 9月 8.3kt，环比虽有改善，但运行水平仍比其 12-13kt/月的常态低约 30% ；Lundin 在 Q3 发布会上将 Caserones FY26 指引再度下调 15kt 至 105-115kt ——这是受天气影响后的又一次下调。Candelaria 9月 11.1kt 保持平稳。 图 5 · Escondida FY27 累计产量 vs 1,000-1,100kt 指引（红虚线）：7-9月累计259kt | Figure 2: Escondida FY'27 production guidance unveiled at 1,000-1,100kt, lower vs FY'26 due to lower grades — Source: Cochilco, company data（原文 p3） 图 6 · Escondida 月度产量跟踪（kt）：9月反弹至93.8kt | Figure 8: Escondida (BHP/RIO) monthly copper production tracker — Source: Cochilco（原文 p5） 图 7 · Quebrada Blanca 月度产量跟踪（kt）：9月降至11.6kt | Figure 12: Quebrada Blanca (Teck) monthly copper production tracker — Source: Cochilco（原文 p6） 图 8 · Caserones 月度产量跟踪（kt）：仍比常态低约30%，FY26指引再降15kt | Figure 19: Caserones (LUN) monthly copper production tracker — Source: Cochilco（原文 p8） Section 04 Antofagasta：四矿平稳，进度约70% Antofagasta: all four mines stable MoM, ~70% of guidance midpoint Antofagasta（OW）四座矿山9月环比全部稳定：Los Pelambres 26.8kt、Centinela 15.4kt、Antucoya 6.6kt、Zaldivar 4.9kt。1-9月累计产量 446kt ，约为公司修正后全年指引中值（ ~640kt ）的 70% ，进度健康。Collahuasi（AAL/GLEN 各44%）9月 30.7kt 环比+4kt，1-9月完成 Glencore 去年12月 CMD 给出的参考指引（44%权益约185kt）的约 67%、JPM 预期的 71%。 图 9 · Antofagasta 2026年累计产量（kt）：9月累计446kt vs 修正后指引中值~640kt | Figure 3: Antofagasta 9M'26 production at 446kt, ~70% of mid-point of revised 2026 production guidance — Source: Cochilco, company data（原文 p3） Section 05 SX-EW 与硫酸市场 SX-EW output unaffected; sulphuric acid prices easing 智利 SX-EW（湿法冶炼）阴极铜产量月度约 90kt ，占全国产量约 23% ，基本未受全球硫酸市场紧张的影响。近期据报道硫酸价格已开始松动：中国硫酸价格从7月峰值 2,107 元/吨 回落至约 1,484 元/吨（约 $222.5/t） （卓创资讯数据）——酸价回落有助于缓解 SX-EW 现金成本压力，对 Codelco、Antofagasta 等拥有湿法产能的厂商边际利好。 结论： 智利供给端的天气扰动正在消退但同比缺口仍大（9月同比-15%）；Codelco 年度目标大概率落空（~1.2Mt vs 1.34Mt），El Teniente 与 Andina 的后续运营数据仍可能带来下行惊喜。个股层面 JPM 维持 Antofagasta OW、Lundin Mining UW。 图 10 · 智利 SX-EW 阴极铜月度产量（kt，2021-2026）：月产约90kt、占全国约23% | Figure 7: Reported Monthly SX-EW cathodes production — Source: Cochilco（原文 p4） 仅供研究参考、不构成投资建议，观点归属原机构。原文版权归 Morgan calculations（原文 p11） 图 11 · 中国原铝产量（Mtpa 年化）：2026年约45Mtpa，逼近运行产能天花板 | Figure 16: China primary aluminium production (Mtpa rate) — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（原文 p12） 图 12 · 中国原铝净进口（Mtpa 年化）：tolling 套利开启下维持净进口 | Figure 20: China primary aluminium net imports (Mtpa rate) — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（原文 p14） Section 05 印尼增量与长期价格 Indonesia ramp-up & long-term price 印尼是2027/28年过剩的核心来源：JPM 商品研究测算印尼铝产量（季度年化）将从1Q23的约 250kt 爬坡至4Q28约 4.2Mt ——Asahan 之外，Huqing Morowali、Kaltara、Bintan 等项目集中投产。 $2,700/t 被定位为"印尼激励价格"——足够覆盖新产能成本并激励持续投产；这也构成 JPM 对2027年价格的锚。长期看，铝实际价格现货约 $2,792/t，历史均值约 $4,033/t（1945年以来实际价格序列）。 图 13 · 印尼铝产量（kt，季度年化）：从1Q23约250kt爬坡至4Q28约4.2Mt | Figure 27: Indonesia aluminium production (kt) – quarterly rate annualised — Source: J.P. Morgan Global Commodities Research（原文 p17） Section 06 覆盖个股与估值 Coverage & valuations 板块交易于 6.5x EV/EBITDA 、股息率 4.5% 。JPM 关键 OW：RIO AU（目标价隐含空间38%）、Hindalco（22%）、Vedanta（18%）、Press Metal（18%）、中铝 2600 HK（72%）、宏桥 1378 HK（53%）；美洲 Neutral Alcoa（25%）、Kaiser Aluminium，OW Constellium；EMEA OW Metlen，Neutral Norsk Hydro（ 负面催化观察 ）与 Ma'aden（14%）。 结论： 当下的极端紧库存（<1Mt、中国约550kt、LME on-warrant 几乎全为俄金属）给了价格短期缓冲，但市场目光已越过1Q27——印尼放量后供需转过剩（2027年约1Mt、2028年约1.5Mt），价格路径趋向 $2,700/t 且风险偏下行。股票层面估值不贵（6.5x EV/EBITDA + 4.5% 股息），OW 龙头与低成本产能所有者。 图 14 · JPM 铝覆盖公司比较表：评级、目标价空间、EV/EBITDA、股息率 | Table 1: J.P. Morgan Securities Australia Limited Key takeaways: (1) Global aluminium production is down 0.6% YTD September, with Arabian Gulf output showing incremental signs of recovery (3.7Mtpa in September vs a 3.3Mtpa trough in April and ~6.2Mtpa pre-disruption); meanwhile apparent global demand was flat YTD (China +2%, RoW -4%). (2) Global visible inventory is at 5 yr lows; stocks have declined aggressively, halving from the May peak (1.75Mt) to ~750kt in November, the lowest levels since at least 2021. Flat demand is outperforming the decline in global supply, triggering stock draws. (3) On pricing, aluminium is up a modest 6% YTD despite the stock draw, potentially reflective of a lack of trader appetite to capitalize on the current tightness due to a forecast surplus in the markets in 2027/28. Alumina is up 31% YTD, despite global supply rising 0.5% Sep YTD (vs Aluminium -0.6%) on what appears to be a normalisation of linkage rates (remains sub 15% to Al), the Alunorte outage, and cost push. The forward curve remains in backwardation, as the market looks through to Gulf restarts into Indonesian supply+5 growth (JPM Commodities sees a 1Mt surplus in 2027 and 1.5Mt in 2028). In Equities, our key OWs are RIO AU, Hindalco, Vedanta, Press Metal, Chalco, Hongqiao Group. In the Americas, we are Neutral on Alcoa and Kaiser Aluminium, but OW on Constellium. In EMEA, we are OW on Metlen, but Neutral on Norsk Hydro (Negative Catalyst Watch) and Ma’aden. The sector is trading at 6.5x EV/TBIDA and an attractive 4.5% dividend yield. Greg Shearer, Head of J.P. Morgan Base and Precious Metals Strategy team noted that following LME week, the debate on aluminium has shifted from whether prices go lower in 2027 to how much lower and how quickly. Near-term, the market remains tight on a thin inventory buffer – global visible stocks have drawn to below 1Mt (Chinese inventory ~550kt), LME on-warrant is now almost exclusively Russian metal, and a backwardated SHFE curve has kept China's tolling import arb open since late September. From 1Q27 the balance looks materially looser: consensus surplus estimates sit at 1-2Mt in 2027 and 2-3Mt in 2028, modestly below the team's own forecasts, with Indonesian ramp-up, limited substitution and few credible upside risks the common thread. The team's base case still sees prices trending towards US$2,700/t through 2027 – the level pegged as the Indonesian incentive price – though risk skews to a harder landing given the cost curve sits well below (WoodMac 90th %-tile C1 ~US$2,200/t, 75th ~US$2,080/t), and prices have spent ~30% of trading days since 2000 below the 90th %-tile. See the team’s note here: Metals Weekly: Takeaways from LME Week 2026 See page 25 for analyst certification and important disclosures, including non-US analyst disclosures. reports.stext: 镍仪表盘：矿石与硫磺成本回落，NPI与MHP利润改善 | J.P. Morgan J.P. MORGAN · 镍 镍仪表盘：矿石与硫磺成本回落，NPI与MHP利润改善 Nickel Dashboard — Improving profitability for intermediaries (NPI & MHP) as ore & sulfur costs fell 机构 J.P. Morgan（Asia Pacific Equity Research） ｜ 日期 2026-11-11 ｜ 页数 20 ｜ 分析师 Benny Kurniawan（PT J.P. Morgan Sekuritas Indonesia）· Lyndon Fagan · Anuja Mandvekar 本页为第三方研报的中文精读整理，观点归属原机构，仅供研究参考。 目录 Contents 核心观点 Key takeaways 价格与估值总览 Price & valuation 库存：过剩仍在累库 Inventory 供需平衡与成本曲线 Balance & cost curve 中间品利润：NPI与MHP profitability 矿石端：宽松的矿与RKAB Ore supply & RKAB 产能扩张与下游需求 Capacity & demand 公司动态与催化剂 Companies & catalysts Section 00 核心观点 Key takeaways 价格： LME 镍 10 月均价 US$15,709/t （环比 -5.0%），月中创年内新低；此后在"中国厂商协调减产 + 2027 年 RKAB 配额收紧预期"驱动下反弹。JPM 商品研究已将全球平衡从大幅过剩下修为 基本平衡 ——印尼精炼镍产量自 2015 年以来首次下降（-4.2% y/y），但价格仍按过剩市场定价：年初至今 LME 库存 累增约 90kt ，缓冲了供给风险。 矿石转松： 印尼矿石价格一个月内下跌 7-9% 。2026 年 RKAB 上调至 290-300mn wmt 、菲律宾进口 9M26 同比 +64.0%，叠加 RKEF 冶炼厂库存充足、不锈钢需求疲弱，前期矿石紧张基本消除；目前矿价较 HPM 基准小幅折价，JPM 认为不可持续。转折点看 1Q27 发布的 2027 年 RKAB 。 中间品利润修复： 硫磺成本自峰值回落约 43% ，即便钴价 -15.0% m/m、MHP 计价系数 <85%，MHP 利差仍修复至 >US$3,800/t 水平；NPI 与硫酸镍价格大体跟随 LME 下行，反映不锈钢与电池材料需求疲弱。 减产信号： 彭博报道青山、华友、格林美、力勤等在印尼的中资镍生产商讨论 MHP 减产至多 50% 、NPI 约 20% 。JPM 认为这是"现价难以为继"的信号，强化 2027 年更大范围供给自律的逻辑——但 持续的复苏需要实际减产落地，而非仅是表态 。 跟踪要点： 2027 年 RKAB 配额、减产执行情况、库存走向。覆盖股票 3Q26 业绩大体符合预期，量增部分对冲了实现价下跌，财报后跑赢 JCI 指数 1-7%。 Section 01 价格与估值总览 Price & valuation overview 10 月 LME 镍均价 US$15,709/t，环比 -5.0% 并创年内新低，驱动因素是矿石供应增加、库存抬升与终端需求疲弱；随后供应侧消息推动反弹。产业链上，NPI 与硫酸镍价格同步走弱：NPI 较 LME 折价约 14% ，硫酸镍折价约 2% ，二者均处于近年低位区间。 Fig 1 · 印尼镍业公司与全球含镍公司估值比较：ANTM/INCO/MDKA 评级均为 OW，目标价 4,700/9,000/3,400（IDR）；印尼镍板块平均 2026E P/E 8.5x、P/BV 1.1x、ROE 18.5%，显著低于全球金属股均值（P/E 18.4x） | Table 1: Valuation comparison – Indonesia nickel players and global players with nickel exposure — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P., J.P. Morgan estimates（J.P. Morgan, p3） Fig 2 · LME 镍、NPI 与硫酸镍价格（US$/t，2013-2026）：10 月 LME 均价 US$15,709/t（-5.0% m/m） | Figure 2: LME nickel, NPI and sulfate prices — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p3） Fig 3 · NPI 与硫酸镍相对 LME 升贴水（%）：NPI 折价约 -14%、硫酸镍约 -2%，仍在低位 | Figure 3: NPI and sulfate premium/(disc) to LME — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p3） 要点： 估值表显示印尼镍板块 2026E 平均 P/E 仅 8.5x、股息率 5.9%，INCO 2026E EPS 增速 8.3%；MDKA 与 NIC 因盈利下滑 P/E 标记 NM。价格已计入大量悲观预期，关键催化在 2027 RKAB。 Section 02 库存：过剩仍在累库 Inventories still building 尽管平衡表转向基本平衡， 显性库存仍在累积 ：年初至今 LME 库存增加约 90kt，部分因中国金属品牌纳入 LME 交割体系后注册仓单增加。库存充裕令下游用户对供应风险的敏感度下降，也压制了价格对减产消息的反应弹性。 Fig 4 · LME+上海镍库存（吨）与 LME 现货价（rhs，US$/t）：中国金属纳入交割后 LME 库存持续抬升，年初至今约 +90kt | Figure 4: Nickel inventory in LME picking up post inclusion of Chinese metals — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p4） Fig 5 · 镍库存按产品拆分（kt）：FFC/进料与珠粒等中间品库存 2025 年以来明显回升 | Figure 8: Inventory breakdown by product — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p4） Section 03 供需平衡与成本曲线 Balance & cost curve JPM 商品研究最新的全球镍平衡表： 2026F 过剩 +101kt → 2027F +54kt → 2028F +26kt ，逐年收敛但尚未转入短缺。结构上，2026F 精炼镍产量 3,805kt（-3.3% y/y），为 2015 年以来首次下降，其中 Class I 2,128kt、化学品/硫酸盐 648kt；需求端不锈钢 2,313kt 仍是基本盘，电池用镍 662kt 增长最快（+8.6%）。 Fig 6 · JPM 全球镍供需平衡表（kt，2016-2028F）：2026F 精炼产量 -3.3%（2015 年以来首降），平衡从 2025 年 +360kt 收敛至 2028F +26kt | Figure 13: Nickel supply and demand balance — Source: Company reports, INSG, ISSF, Bloomberg New Energy Finance, Wood Mackenzie, CRU, J.P. Morgan Commodities Research（J.P. Morgan, p5） 成本端，全球镍成本曲线的 50 分位线（约 US$13,000-15,000/t 区域）历来是 LME 价格的支撑位；当前价格贴近 50-75 分位之间，25 分位现金成本线仍在价格下方，尚未触发大规模成本性减产。 Fig 7 · 镍成本曲线与 LME 均价（LHS: US$/t；RHS: kt）：50 分位通常是 LME 支撑位，红框标示 2012-2016 与 2023-2026 两轮价格贴近成本区间 | Figure 10: Nickel cost curve – 50th percentile is usually the support level for LME — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P., Wood Mackenzie, J.P. Morgan Commodities Research（J.P. Morgan, p5） Section 04 中间品利润：NPI 与 MHP Intermediaries: NPI & MHP profitability 本报告标题主线： 矿石与硫磺成本回落令中间品利润改善 。NPI 的 ASP 与现金成本之差（一体化冶炼厂利差）自低位回升；MHP 方面，硫磺酸（硫酸）价格自 2026 年峰值回落约 43%，即便钴价环比 -15.0%、MHP 计价系数低于 85%， HPAL 利差仍修复至 >US$3,800/t 。 Fig 8 · NPI ASP、现金成本与利差（US$/t）：一体化冶炼厂利差（rhs）自 2025 年低位回升 | Figure 11: NPI ASP, cash cost and spreads — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P., J.P. Morgan estimates（J.P. Morgan, p5） Fig 9 · 中国 98% 硫酸价格（CNY/t）：2025-26 年初冲高后大幅回落，自峰值约 -43%，是 MHP 利差修复的主因 | Figure 17: Sulfuric acid price — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p6） 减产博弈： 彭博报道青山、华友、格林美、力勤等讨论 MHP 减产至多 50%、NPI 约 20%。JPM 解读为生产商用行动传递"现价不可持续"的信号，利差改善反而强化了 2027 年供给自律扩大的必要性——2027 年 HPAL 产能将再增约 377kt，若无供给响应，过剩将延续。 Section 05 矿石端：宽松的矿与 RKAB Ore supply & RKAB quotas 印尼矿石价格过去一个月下跌 7-9% ：2026 年 RKAB 配额上调至 290-300mn wmt 、菲律宾进口放量（9M26 同比 +64.0%）令矿石紧张基本消除；RKEF 冶炼厂原料库存充足，不锈钢弱势抑制补库。矿价目前较 HPM 基准价小幅折价——JPM 认为该折价不可持续，但 4Q26 剩余配额交付期内矿价仍将偏软。 转折点在 1Q27 的 2027 年 RKAB ：若首批配额偏紧叠加菲律宾雨季发货放缓，矿价有望在 2027 年初重新获得支撑。 Fig 10 · 印尼镍矿价格（US$/wmt）：1.6% 腐殖土（saprolite）与 1.2% 褐铁（limonite）到岸价，前者自峰值回落约 34%；本次新增两组矿石价格数据系列 | Figure 14: Indonesia nickel ore prices — Source: Shanghai Metals Market（J.P. Morgan, p6） Fig 11 · 菲律宾 1.5% 镍矿价格（US$/t）：2026 年回落至 US$55-60/t 区间 | Figure 19: Philippines 1.5% Nickel Ore — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p6） Fig 12 · 主要产矿国镍矿产量（kt，年化）：印尼 2026 年 8 月年化 2,402ktpa（全球占比约 58%），菲律宾雨季后回升至 649ktpa；全球 YTD 同比 +1% | Table 2: Nickel mining production by major producer — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p7） Fig 13 · 中国镍矿港口库存（kwmt）：季节性明显，2026 年回到约 4,000-5,000kwmt 的偏低水平 | Figure 25: China nickel ore stocks — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p9） Section 06 产能扩张与下游需求 Capacity buildout & demand 供给扩张的中期压力未消： 印尼 HPAL 产能从 2023 年 265kt 增至 2026E 597kt，2027E 达 974kt（一年净增约 377kt）、2028E 1,091kt ；RKEF 产能 2025 年起亦有新增。需求端，中国不锈钢产量与钢材净出口是 NPI 价格的核心变量——历史上净出口高企时 NPI 价格承压；2026 年中国净出口仍处高位，对 NPI 价格形成压制。EV 需求则由主导——中国占全球 EV 销量约 60-80%，全球电池总需求 2026E 约 2,580GWh（+25.0%），电池用镍持续增长。 Fig 14 · 印尼 HPAL 产能（kt）：2023 年 265 → 2026E 597 → 2027E 974 → 2028E 1,091，2027 年净增约 377kt | Figure 21: HPAL capacity in Indonesia — Source: Company reports, Wood Mackenzie, J.P. Morgan estimates（J.P. Morgan, p7） Fig 15 · 中国钢材净出口（Mt）与 NPI 价格（rhs 反轴，US$/t）：净出口高企时 NPI 价格走弱，2026 年两者关系再度应验 | Figure 22: China net steel exports and NPI prices – prices decline when net exports are high — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p9） Fig 16 · 全球 EV 销量（千辆）由中国主导：中国占比长期维持约 60-80%，是硫酸镍-电池链需求的支柱 | Figure 27: Global EV sales are dominated by China — Source: Bloomberg Finance L.P.（J.P. Morgan, p9） Section 07 公司动态与催化剂 Companies & catalysts Weda Bay Nickel 股权引多方兴趣： Eramet 在最新公告中表示已收到多家投资者对其持股的意向。Eramet 现持 WBN 38.7%（ANTM 10%、青山 51.3%），意在去杠杆，但年内不会交割确认收益。WBN 截至 9M26 账面价值 IDR24tn（约 US$1.3bn） ，保有储量 892mn wmt、平均品位 1.34% （其中湿法冶金用矿 250mn wmt @1.16%、火法用矿 642mn wmt @1.40%）。 覆盖股票 3Q26 绩后跑赢： 财报后 ANTM、INCO、MDKA、NIC 跑赢 JCI 指数 1-7%，核心是矿石量增长与矿价回落对冲了镍价疲弱。4Q26 量价预计延续 3Q 轨迹；LME 价格下跌对损益的拖累小于表面，因为公司同时销售 NPI/FeNi，后者有独立的供需平衡。 2027 年 RKAB 是核心催化剂： 配额规模将同时决定矿石、中间品的价格与量的展望，也是矿价折价能否收敛的关键。 结论： 中间品利润修复（硫磺成本 -43%、MHP 利差 >US$3,800/t）+ 减产表态是本轮反弹的实质支撑，但库存 +90kt 与 HPAL 2027 年 +377kt 产能决定了行情的持续性取决于"减产执行"与"2027 RKAB 紧缩"两大验证点——在证据落地前，JPM 对反弹的持续性保持谨慎。 本页由研报阅读工具自动整理生成，仅供研究参考、不构成投资建议；观点与数据归属 J.P. Morgan 原报告（2026-11-11）。 原文版权归 J.P. Morgan 所有。

LME nickel averaged US$15,709/t in October (-5% m/m), hitting a new YTD low mid-month as rising ore availability, higher inventories and weak end-use demand weighed on sentiment. Prices have since rebounded, driven largely by supply-side developments, including reports of coordinated production cuts by Chinese producers and expectations of tighter 2027 RKAB quotas. Fundamentals have also improved. Our Commodities Research team has revised its balance from a large surplus to a broadly balanced market (link), with Indonesian refined output set to fall for the first time since 2015 (-4.2% y/y). Yet prices still trade as though the market is oversupplied - YTD inventories have risen by 90kt, shielding consumers from supply risks. Weakness also remains evident across the value chain. Upstream, ore prices have fallen as lower HPM benchmarks, stronger Philippine imports (+64% y/y in 9M26) and the upward revision of the 2026 RKAB eased concerns about ore tightness. Among the intermediaries, NPI and nickel sulfate broadly mirrored the LME decline, reflecting subdued stainless and battery- material demand. While discussions of 20-50% production cuts have lifted sentiment, we think a sustained recovery will require evidence of actual supply contraction rather than headline announcements. Looking ahead, we remain focused on the 2027 RKAB, the implementation of proposed cuts and inventory trends. Within our coverage, 3Q26 results were broadly in line, with resilient volume growth helping offset weaker realised prices. For more on nickel and metal-related research, see our Indonesia Commodity Tracker (link) and Gregory Shearer and team's report (link). We are also introducing two new data sets: 1.6% saprolite ore price and 1.2% limonite ore price in Figure 14 Indonesia nickel ore prices. • Ore prices stay weak despite tighter 2027 signals: Indonesian ore prices have fallen 7-9% over the past month as supply eased while demand remained subdued. The upward revision of the 2026 RKAB to 290-300mn wmt, together with stronger Philippine imports, has effectively removed the ore tightness seen earlier this year. At the same time, RKEF smelters are well stocked and weak stainless demand has limited restocking. We expect prices to stay soft through 4Q as the remaining 2026 quotas are delivered. The turning point is likely the 2027 RKAB release in 1Q27. A restrictive initial quota, combined with seasonally slower Philippine shipments, could tighten ore supply again and support prices in early 2027. Ore prices are currently trading at a slight discount to HPM (benchmark price) which in our view is not sustainable. • HPAL production cuts: Bloomberg reported that major Chinese nickel producers in Indonesia, including Tsingshan, Huayou, GEM and Lygend, are considering output reductions of up to 50% for MHP and ~20% for NPI (link). Notably, these talks come as spreads are moderating from a decline in sulfur costs down ~43% from its peak. Spreads have improved to >US$3,800/t levels, despite lower cobalt prices (-15% m/m) and MHP payabilities (<85%). In our view, producers are signaling that current prices can't last without a supply response, which strengthens the case for a wider supply discipline into 2027, which is expected to see a ~377kt increase in HPAL capacity. (Figure 21HPAL capacity in Indonesia) • Eramet receives interest for its 38.7% stake in Weda Bay Nickel. Eramet in its latest press release (link) indicated that it has received interest from several investors for a majority stake in WBN. Eramet currently owns 38.7% of WBN, while the remaining stakes are owned by ANTM (10%) and See page 15 for analyst certification and important disclosures, including non-US analyst disclosures. Weaker LME prices should weigh less than the headline suggests, as the companies also sell NPI/FeNi, which have their own supply-demand balances. reports.stext: 杰富瑞：历史视角下的黄金前景 · 中文总结（2026-11-18） JEFFERIES · GLOBAL METALS & MINING · 黄金 历史视角下的黄金前景 What History Says About Gold from Here 机构 Jefferies ｜ 栏目 Global Metals & Mining（Equity Research） ｜ 报告日期 2026-11-18 作者 Giovanni Holmes · Fahad Tariq · Christopher LaFemina, CFA ｜ AI 中文精读 · 观点归属 Jefferies 本页为 AI 生成的中文精读总结，仅供研究参考；全部观点与数据归属 Jefferies 原报告（8 页，第 4–8 页为合规披露）。 目录 Contents 核心观点 Key Takeaways 筛选方法：如何找到"最像当下"的历史时期 Finding the Closest Matches 相似环境下的平淡回报 Muted Gold Returns in Similar Regimes 当下与历史的三大不同 Where Today Differs 收益率曲线熊市走平压制黄金 A Flattening Yield Curve Has Pressured Gold 最接近的对照：2024 年 3 月 The Closest Match 数据表精读：当今宏观 vs 历史与七大相似周 Today's Setup vs History 结论与风险 Conclusion & Risks 合规披露说明 Disclosures SECTION 00 · KEY TAKEAWAYS 核心观点 Key Takeaways 做法： Jefferies 用 1976 年以来约 50 年的周度宏观数据做筛选，寻找与当下（2026-11-13 当周）在通胀、利率、财政等维度最相似的历史时期，再统计其后 3 / 6 / 12 个月的黄金回报。 六条件同刻满足才入围： WTI 同比 >20%、CPI 同比 >2.5%、10Y 美债收益率 >4%、联邦基金目标利率 >3%、联邦毛利息支出 >2.5% of GDP、30Y 收益率高于一年前——当下全部满足，1976 年以来共 168 周合格。 结果偏弱： 与当下最相似的 7 周，其后 12 个月黄金平均仅上涨 3.2%（全样本为 9.1%），且仅 42.9% 的时段录得正收益（全样本 59.1%）；区间从 -21.7%（1996-12）到 +38.8%（2024-03）。 但最像且最近的对照是 2024 年 3 月： 该周在选定宏观变量上以明显优势最接近当下，此后 12 个月黄金上涨约 39% 且无大幅回撤。 结论： 央行储备多元化 + 发达经济体财政压力使当下"不寻常"，宏观因素未来数月更可能转向利好黄金—— 1 年维度维持看涨，但短期波动难免 。 Section 01 筛选方法：如何找到"最像当下"的历史时期 Finding the Closest Matches 报告对 1976 年以来的周度宏观数据做逐周筛选，只有在 六项条件同时成立 的周才被视为"与当下可比"： WTI 油价同比涨幅 >20%； CPI 同比 >2.5%； 10Y 美债收益率 >4%； 联邦基金目标利率 >3%； 美国联邦毛利息支出（gross federal interest outlays）>2.5% of GDP； 30Y 收益率高于一年前。 1976 年以来共 168 周 全部达标。在此基础上，报告用 十一个因子 衡量各周与当下的接近程度，并归入五个 等权主题 （利率、财政、黄金动能等），避免某组相关变量主导排序；最后对入围周按"距离"（越小越近）排名，取前七位，并统计其后 3、6、12 个月的黄金回报。 要点： "油涨 + 通胀粘性 + 债市要更高收益率"三件事同时出现，是这批历史可比期的共同特征——这正是 2026 年 11 月当下的宏观组合。 Section 02 相似环境下的平淡回报 Muted Gold Returns in Similar Regimes 七个最相似可比期（comp）此后 12 个月平均涨幅仅 3.2% ，且只有 43% 的时间上涨；而全样本（2,499 周）平均为 9.1%、上涨概率 59.1%。历史回报偏弱的一个常见原因是： 实际收益率高企与紧缩政策在这类时期往往延续 。七个可比周分别是： 1987-08： 恰逢全球债市抛售； 1991-06： 海湾战争油价冲击之后； 1995-02： 美联储 1994 年加息与债市大跌之后； 1996-12： 油价大涨 + 美元走强（最差样本，12 个月 -21.7%）； 1982-84 的两例（1982-05、1984-02）： 反映 Volcker 时代政策与里根赤字扩张。 2024-03： 唯一 2000 年后的样本，也是最好的一个（12 个月 +38.8%）。 图 1 · 可比宏观环境下的黄金回报（指数化，100 = 触发周/当下） | Gold Returns Around Comparable Macro Setups — Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, U.S. Office of Management and Budget via FRED, FactSet, Jefferies（Jefferies 报告 p2） 稳健性检验——剔除油价： 若不把油价计入相关宏观因子（即放宽"WTI 同比>20%"的约束），可比条件下黄金 12 个月平均回报从 3.2% 回升至 8.4% ，接近全样本均值——说明"高油价"这一筛选条件本身是拉低历史均值的重要原因。 图 2 · 剔除油价因子后的可比环境黄金回报（Comp Average 12-Month Return: 8.4%） | Gold Returns Around Comparable Macro Setups, Ex-Oil — Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, U.S. OMB via FRED, FactSet, Jefferies（Jefferies 报告 p2） Section 03 当下与历史的三大不同 Where Today Differs 实际收益率水平： 1990 年代可比期的实际收益率远高于当下（closest comps 平均实际 10Y 约 4.24% vs 当下 1.34%）——历史上高实际收益率是压制金价的主因，当下并非如此。 央行行为： 2009 年之前各国央行整体是黄金净卖出方，此后转为净买入，且 2021 年以来购买规模显著放大（储备多元化），这是历史 comp 无法反映的结构性支撑。 财政约束（可能是最大差异）： 1990 年代美国靠加税、低利率再融资债务、削减冷战国防开支"修平"了高企的债务利息负担；这些选项如今基本不在桌上，长期更可能指向 更高通胀 + 更低实际利率 ——利好黄金，也是当下 30Y 收益率与金价转为正相关的原因之一。 Section 04 收益率曲线熊市走平压制黄金 A Flattening Yield Curve Has Pressured Gold 历史规律： 收益率曲线变陡（steepening）时黄金倾向跑赢，走平（flattening）时倾向跑输 。当前美国已进入 熊市走平（bear flattening） 阶段（长端 30Y 相对 10Y 承压、利差收窄），这一环境对包括黄金在内的多数金属并不理想——与报告的年内观察一致：金价同比涨幅已随利差收窄而回落。 图 3 · 10Y–30Y 利差与黄金同比涨幅（2016-11 → 2026-07） | 10s30s vs Gold — Source: FactSet, Jefferies（Jefferies 报告 p2） Section 05 最接近的对照：2024 年 3 月 The Closest Match: March 2024 在选定宏观变量上， 2024 年 3 月以明显优势成为与当下最接近的一周 （距离 0.380，第二名 1996-12 为 0.645）：当时通胀水平与利息支出负担与当下相仿，油价正在上行，收益率与政策利率处于高位。此后 12 个月黄金 上涨约 39%（NTM）且未出现重大回撤 。 它也是最近的可比期、唯一一个 2000 年之后的样本，因此更好地反映了当下的市场结构与 ETF 通道——尽管并非完美对标。 含义： 表面上看历史均值（3.2%）令人担忧，但"最像当下的那一次"指向的是大幅跑赢；叠加央行购金与财政压力两个结构性因素，Jefferies 选择站在看多一边。 Section 06 数据表精读：当今宏观 vs 历史与七大相似周 Today's Setup vs History in Tables 表 1 ：与 1976 年以来全历史均值相比，当下的特别之处在于——油价同比 +47.4%（历史均值 +7.9%）、10Y/30Y 收益率一年内分别上行 1.01pp / 0.73pp（历史均值约为 -0.06pp）、联邦毛利息支出占 GDP 3.94%（历史均值 2.36%）、美元同比走强 4.1%；而实际 10Y（1.34%）与政策利率（4.00%）仍显著低于历史均值与 comp 均值。 图 4 · 当今宏观背景 vs 历史（CPI 3.8% 为估计值） | Today's macro backdrop vs. history — Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, U.S. OMB, FactSet, Jefferies（Jefferies 报告 p3） 表 2 ：全样本（2,499 周）其后 3/6/12 个月平均回报为 2.1% / 4.3% / 9.1%，12 个月上涨概率 59.1%；七个最相似周为 3.4% / 4.6% / 3.2%，12 个月上涨概率仅 42.9%——前 6 个月并不差，差距主要在 6→12 个月段拉开。 图 5 · 触发后 3、6、12 个月黄金表现 | What gold did next (3, 6 and 12 months later) — Source: 同上（Jefferies 报告 p3） 表 3 ：七大相似周明细。7 个 comp 中只有 3 个（2024-03 +38.8%、1982-05 +32.5%、1995-02 +5.7%）在 12 个月后录得正收益；1996-12 与 1984-02 均 -21.7%。注意 1982/1984 两行 CPI 缺失（当时口径不同）。 图 6 · 与当今最相似的七个历史周（距离越小越接近；3.8% CPI 为估计值） | Closest comparable weeks to today — Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, U.S. OMB, FactSet, Jefferies（Jefferies 报告 p3） Section 07 结论与风险 Conclusion & Risks 与当下宏观结构相似的历史时期，黄金回报 喜忧参半、均值弱于全样本 ——表面令人担忧。但两条关键保留意见支撑多头结论： a) 最接近、也最近的可比期（2024-03）指向从此大幅跑赢； b) 当下是独特的：央行储备多元化 + 全球发达经济体面临的财政压力，在历史 comp 中找不到对应物。 Jefferies 认为未来数月关键宏观因素 更可能开始向有利于黄金的方向移动 ，1 年维度上总体维持 看涨（positive on balance） ；期间预计会有波动。附带风险提示：样本仅 7 周、区间极宽（-21.7% → +38.8%），若实际收益率与紧缩政策如 1990 年代般持续，历史均值那一幕可能重演。报告另提供可调参数的"黄金周期（gold regimes）"工具，供客户自行调整宏观过滤器复现结果。 Section 08 合规披露说明 Disclosures (pp. 4–8) 原报告第 4–8 页为分析师认证（Giovanni Holmes — Jefferies International Limited；Fahad Tariq — Jefferies Securities, Inc.；Christopher LaFemina, CFA — Jefferies LLC）、评级定义（Buy：12 个月总回报 ≥15%；Hold：+15% 至 -10%；Underperform：≤-10%）、评级分布（Buy 2,274 只 / 63.01%，Hold 1,196 只 / 33.14%，Underperform 139 只 / 3.85%）、估值方法论与各地辖区法律声明，属标准合规文本，无增量投资观点，此处仅作摘要索引。 免责声明：本文件为 AI 生成的中文精读总结，仅供研究参考、不构成投资建议；全部观点与数据归属 Jefferies 及原作者（Giovanni Holmes / Fahad Tariq / Christopher LaFemina）。 Source reports.ftext: Global | Metals & Mining Equity Research November 18, 2026 Giovanni Holmes * | Equity Analyst +44 20 7548 4172 | gholmes@jefferies.com Fahad Tariq ^ | Equity Analyst +1 (416) 637-2372 | ftariq@jefferies.com Christopher LaFemina, CFA ‡ | Equity Analyst +1 (212) 336-7304 | clafemina@jefferies.com What History Says About Gold from Here We screened 50 years of weekly data for periods resembling today's inflation, rates and fiscal backdrop. Gold rose an average 3.2% over 12m after the seven closest comps vs 9.1% overall, with a wide range (-21.7% to +38.8%). Those returns look muted, but the closest and most recent comp, Mar 2024, saw gold rise 39%, and CB reserve diversification and fiscal pressures make today unusual. We stay positive on gold on a 1-year view but expect near-term volatility. Finding the Closest Matches: We screened weekly macro data back to 1976 for periods that resemble today, on the factors most relevant to gold. A comparable period qualifies only if six conditions hold together: WTI >20% y/y, CPI >2.5% y/y, 10Y Treasury yields >4%, fed funds target >3%, US gross federal interest outlays >2.5% of GDP, and 30Y yields higher than a year ago. Today clears every hurdle. Of the 168 qualifying weeks, we ranked the closest to today across eleven factors, grouped into five equally weighted themes (such as rates, fiscal, gold momentum) so no block of related variables dominates. We then measured gold returns 3, 6, and 12 months later. Muted Gold Returns in Similar Regimes: The seven closest comps averaged a 12m gain of only 3.2%, and gold rose in just 43% of them, versus a 9.1% average gain and 59% hit rate over the full sample. A common reason for relatively weak returns was that real yields and tight policy tended to persist in previous comps. The range is wide, however, from -21.7% (Dec 1996) to +38.8% (Mar 2024) and sample size is small. Each historical period combined rising oil, sticky inflation and a bond market demanding more. Aug 1987 came during a global bond selloff. Jun 1991 followed the Gulf War oil spike. Feb 1995 came after the Fed's 1994 hikes and bond rout. Dec 1996 saw a big oil rise and a firm dollar. The 1982-84 cases reflect Volcker- era policy and widening Reagan deficits. Where Today Differs: Real yields were far higher in the 1990s comps. Central banks also differed. Many were net sellers until 2009, after which they have been net buyers and in large sizes post-2021. But perhaps the biggest difference is fiscal-related. In the 1990s the US fixed its historically elevated debt interest burden by raising taxes, refinancing debt at lower rates and cutting Cold War defence spending. Those options may now be off the table, which could imply higher inflation and lower real rates over the long term. This could be supportive of gold, and part of why 30Y yields are now positively correlated with it (more HERE). The Closest Match: By contrast, March 2024 ranks as the closest match to today by a clear margin on select macro variables. Inflation and interest outlays were similar, while oil was rising and yields and policy rates were at elevated levels. Gold then rose strongly (+39% over the NTM) with no major drawdowns. It is also the most recent comp and the only one after 2000, so we would argue it better reflects today's market structure and ETF access, although it is not perfect. Conclusion: Gold returns following similar macro setups to today have been mixed, and on average weaker than the full sample. This is somewhat concerning at face value. But important caveats are that: a) the closest and most recent comp points to outperformance from here, and b) today is unique, mostly because of CB reserve diversification and the fiscal pressures facing developed economies globally. We think it is more likely that key macro factors begin to move in gold's favour in the coming months, and stay positive on balance over a 1-year view. Volatility is expected in the meantime. reports.stext: 关键矿产：美中依赖——狭窄但重要 | Macquarie MACQUARIE · 关键矿产 关键矿产：美中依赖——狭窄但重要 Critical Minerals — The US and China: a narrow but important dependency 机构 Macquarie（Global Macro Strategy / Group Economics） ｜ 日期 2026-11-18 ｜ 页数 14 ｜ 经济学家 Ric Deverell · Hayden Skilling, CFA · Anita Chao 本页为第三方研报的中文精读整理，观点归属原机构（Macquarie 销售与交易/集团经济部观点，非 Macquarie Research 产品），仅供研究参考。 目录 Contents 核心观点 Key takeaways 引言：战略分量远超经济体量 Introduction 需求：不止能源转型 Demand beyond the transition 供给扩张与集中度瓶颈 Supply & concentration 美国的进口依赖 US import dependence 对华直接依赖下降及其局限 Reduced direct reliance on China 澳大利亚：战略机遇、经济有限 Australia 全球贸易：战略重要性 ≠ 经济规模 Trade scale Section 00 核心观点 Key takeaways 体量小、分量重： 按 UNCTAD 口径，全球关键矿产贸易 2024 年达 US$2.2tn （占全球 GDP 2.0%），但其中近 80% 由六种矿贡献（黄金、铁矿与钢铁、铜、铝、冶金煤、钻石）——它们大多不在各国关键矿产清单上；真正卡脖子的品种市场极小：全球稀土出口仅约 US$2.1bn ，"其他金属"（镓、锗、铟、铌、钽、钒）约 US$3.3bn 。 美国进口膨胀但对华直接依赖骤降： 2025 年美国关键矿产进口 US$81bn （2024 年 US$67bn），其中自中国进口从 US$2.0bn 降至 US$1.1bn （占比 2.9% → 1.4%），中国从第 8 大来源国滑落至第 16 位；中国仅仍是稀土、钽、钨的第一大来源。 但"去中国化"要打折扣： 部分进口（尤其石墨、锑）转向了由中国资本深度参股采矿/加工/冶炼/贸易的第三国—— 供应链层面的依赖降幅小于直接进口数据所显示的 。 依赖在加深而非缓解： 美国 60 种关键矿产中 13 种 100% 净进口依赖 （2024 年 12 种，钛新增）、另有 34 种依赖度 >50% （新增铜、钯、硅）。 澳大利亚：战略赢家、经济有限： 关键矿产出口 2025-26 财年约 A$16.5bn（占 GDP 0.55%） ，远低于 LNG（A$55bn，1.9%）与铁矿（A$119bn，4.1%）；未来四年峰值预计 A$26bn、仍低于 GDP 的 1%。机遇本质上是 战略性的 （国防安全与盟友供应链多元化），不宜高估其宏观意义。 Section 01 引言：战略分量远超经济体量 Punching well above their weight 这是 Macquarie 去年底《Critical Minerals – US imports from China: small $, big impact》的周年更新。三条老结论依然成立： ① 关键矿产的经济分量远超其市场体量 ——小市场支撑着大产业； ② 资源可得 ≠ 供应安全 ——冶炼、加工与制造产能高度集中于他处时，占有矿权并不等于安全； ③ 供应链多元化创造的是战略机遇而非变革性经济机遇 ——除非价格大涨，替代供应国的经济收益有限。 Fig 1 · 中国出口管制对美国 GDP 的影响（2023 年实际美元，按行业）：镓、锗、钛铁合金、钨等小品种矿的断供足以重创半导体、轻卡、导弹与航天制造等大产业 | Figure 1: While many critical minerals markets are relatively small, they support significantly larger industries — Source: Nassar et al. (2025), USGS, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p2） Fig 2 · 中国稀土与磁材产量占全球份额（%）：采矿约 58%、冶炼约 90%、磁材制造约 92%——拥有矿权并不等于供应安全，瓶颈在下游 | Figure 2: Access to raw mineral resources does not necessarily translate into secure supply — Source: IEA (2025), Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p3） Section 02 需求：不止能源转型 Demand beyond the energy transition 关键矿产常与能源转型绑定，但应用面宽得多：半导体、数字基础设施、航空航天、国防、医疗、农业与化工均依赖。对比两端： 镍 只有不到 20% 的需求与能源技术相关，而 锂 约 75% 的需求来自电动车与电网储能。多元的终端用途意味着需求同时受能源转型、产业政策、制造业回流与战略产业投资等多重结构性趋势支撑。 Fig 3 · 关键矿产终端用途分类表：能源转型与电气化、半导体与数字技术、航空航天与国防、先进制造与冶金、医疗、农业、催化与化工七大类 | Figure 4: Critical minerals' applications extend well beyond the energy transition — Source: USGS (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p3） 增长前景上， 锂 被普遍预期为主要关键矿产中增速最快者：Macquarie 预计 2025-2030 年全球锂原生需求 接近翻倍 ，几乎全部由电动车与储能驱动； 镍 同期全球原生消费约 +35% 、 铜 约 +15%，磁体稀土与石墨亦有可观增幅。IEA 至 2040 年的预测呈现相似的相对格局，但对技术部署与政策设定高度敏感。 Fig 4 · 全球锂原生需求及累计增长贡献（%，2025-2030，Macquarie 预测）：电动车+电网储能贡献绝大部分增量，总需求接近翻倍 | Figure 7: We expect global primary demand for lithium to almost double between 2025 and 2030 — Source: Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p4） Fig 5 · 主要关键矿产需求增长（%，2025-2040，按情景）：锂增速居首，石墨/镍/磁体稀土次之，铜钴温和；STEPS 与高需求情景差异巨大 | Figure 8: Demand for selected critical minerals is expected to increase significantly through to 2040 — Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p4） Section 03 供给扩张与集中度瓶颈 Supply expansion, refining bottleneck 地缘紧张与需求前景刺激了全产业链投资，澳大利亚更新版《关键矿产战略》更加强调国家安全与国内加工冶炼。近年 精炼供应增速普遍跑赢需求 ——唯一例外是钴：2023-24 年严重过剩叠加刚果（金）2025 年出口禁令，2025 年精炼钴供应下降。但新增精炼产能大多仍落在最大生产国， 2023→2025 年铜、锂、镍的精炼集中度不降反升 ，石墨精炼集中度维持约 95%；仅精炼钴与磁体稀土有所分散。采矿端稍好：稀土、锂、石墨采矿集中度因拉美/非洲新项目投产而回落。 除镍以外，中国仍是所有这些品种的主导冶炼枢纽 。 Fig 6 · 主要矿产供需增长对比（%，2024-25）：除钴外（精炼供应下滑），各品种精炼供应增速普遍高于需求 | Figure 10: Despite strong demand growth, refined product supply growth generally outpaced demand growth, except for cobalt — Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p5） Fig 7 · 2025 年采矿与冶炼集中度（最大生产国份额 vs 2023）：冶炼端铜锂镍集中度上升、石墨约 95%；采矿端稀土/锂/石墨有所分散 | Figure 11: Critical minerals refined product supply has generally become more concentrated, while mining concentration has seen mixed outcomes — Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p6） 瓶颈难解： IEA 基准情形（按融资/许可/可研状态加权的项目管线）显示，至 2040 年 采矿集中度多数下降、但前三大生产国集中度仍高 ；冶炼端则涨跌互现——铜、镍、钴更集中，锂、石墨、磁体稀土略分散。冶炼加工需要规模、技术诀窍与成熟下游链条，而中国数十年投资形成的矿-冶-造-运一体化生态难以复制。供应链韧性建设仍有大量工作要做。 Section 04 美国的进口依赖 US import dependence keeps rising 2025 年美国的进口依赖 不降反升 ：60 种关键矿产中 13 种 100% 净进口依赖 （新增钛）、 34 种依赖度超过 50% （新增铜、钯、硅，稀土类含 14 种镧系）、仅 6 种低于 50%（2024 年为 9 种）、净出口仅 3 种（铍、硼、冶金煤）。全年关键矿产进口约 US$81bn ，同比 +US$14bn，主要由铜、PGM、白银拉动：前五大品种（铜、铝、PGM、银、铀）合计约 US$58bn、占比超过 70% 。铜进口从 US$11.5bn 增至近 US$19bn ，很大程度是抢在预期铜关税前囤货（量价齐升）。备受关注的稀土进口其实只有 US$211mn （2024 年 US$175mn）。 Fig 8 · 美国关键矿产净进口依赖度（% 表观消费，2025 vs 2024）：砷/铯/氟石/石墨/锰/云母/REEs/铷等 13 种 100% 依赖，47 种以上超过 50% | Figure 13: The US was more than 50% net import reliant for at least 47 critical minerals in 2025, up from at least 44 in 2024 — Source: EIA, USGS, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p8） Fig 9 · 美国关键矿产进口结构（US$bn，按矿种，2025 vs 2024）：铜从 11.5 增至近 19（关税抢跑），铝约 9，PGM、白银、铀居前 | Figure 14: US critical minerals imports increased to ~$81bn in 2025, up from ~$67bn in 2024 — Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p9） Fig 10 · 美国关键矿产进口来源国（US$bn，2025 vs 2024）：加拿大 24%、智利 12%、墨西哥 9.0%、南非 7.8%、韩国 4.2%；中国仅 1.4%，从第 8 大来源跌至第 16 | Figure 15: China accounted for just $1.1 bn of US critical minerals imports in 2025 (1.4% of the total) — Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p10） Section 05 对华直接依赖下降及其局限 Less direct reliance on China — with caveats 2025 年自华进口普遍回落：除 8 个品种外全部下降，最大拖累是 铀（-US$205mn）、石墨（-US$185mn）、锑（-US$124mn） ，唯一显著上升的是锆（+US$20mn）。中国失去石墨、锑、铯、铟、铋的第一大来源国地位（多数恰是 2023-25 年中国出口管制的对象），2025 年只保住 稀土（含 16 种矿物）、钽、钨 三个品种的第一名——且份额同样在降。 Fig 11 · 美国自华关键矿产进口（US$mn，按矿种，2025 vs 2024）：石墨约 390 仍居首（中国占美进口份额约 27%），稀土 211、钽、钨次之 | Figure 17: US imports from China fell for all but eight critical minerals in 2025 — Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p10） 重要保留： 直接进口依赖下降 ≠ 供应链依赖同步下降。石墨、锑等品种的进口流向了在采矿、加工、冶炼或贸易环节仍有大量中资商业参与的第三国—— 广义供应链对华依赖的降幅小于直接进口数据显示的水平 。这一口径（美国关键矿产清单、剔除含关键矿产的制成品）本身也低估了暴露度。 Section 06 澳大利亚：战略机遇、经济有限 Australia: strategic winner, modest economics 结论与一年前一致：澳大利亚将凭资源禀赋与项目管线在供应链多元化中扮演更大角色， 收益主要是战略与外交层面的 。数据上：2025-26 财年关键矿产出口约 A$16.5bn（占 GDP 0.55%） ，同期 LNG 约 A$55bn（1.9%）、铁矿石 A$119bn（4.1%）；即便未来四年随稀土、锂、锑新项目投产升至峰值约 A$26bn ，占 GDP 仍不足 1%（且高度依赖价格假设）。 Fig 12 · 澳大利亚各类资源出口占 GDP 比重（%，2025-26）：关键矿产 0.55%，远低于铁矿石 4.1%、LNG 1.9%、非货币黄金、冶金煤与热煤 | Figure 19: Critical minerals exports were A$16½ bn in 2025-26 (~0.55% of GDP) — Source: ABS, Department of Industry, Science & Resources, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p11） Section 07 全球贸易：战略重要性 ≠ 经济规模 Strategic importance ≠ economic scale UNCTAD 整合各国清单形成的 60 种矿物分析口径（含"转型必需/转型相关/其他关键"三组）显示：全球关键矿产出口从 2002 年约 US$0.4tn（占全球 GDP 1.1%） 增至近年的 US$2.2tn（2.0%） ——但增量主要来自 2000 年代初中国大宗热潮、以涨价为主，占 GDP 比重与 19 年前相当。结构上高度集中： 黄金、铁矿与钢铁、铜、铝、冶金煤、钻石六大市场合计约 US$1.8tn、占比近 80% ；稀土（2024 年全球出口仅 US$2.1bn）与"其他金属"（镓锗铟铌钽钒，约 US$3.3bn）等战略品种在经济体量上是"小市场"。地区分布上，亚洲与欧洲在多数品类占据最大出口份额，反映矿产禀赋与下游加工制造产能的集中。 Fig 13 · 全球关键矿产出口（US$tn 左轴 / 占全球 GDP % 右轴，2002-2024）：名义值升至 2.2tn，占 GDP 约 2.0% 与 19 年前持平 | Figure 21: Critical minerals exports rose from around $0.4 tn in 2002 (1.1% of global GDP) to more than $2.2 tn (2.0%) — Source: IMF, UNCTAD, Macrobond, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p12） Fig 14 · 全球关键矿产出口按品类与地区拆分（US$bn，2024）：金/铁钢/铜/铝/冶金煤六大品类占近 80%；稀土与镓锗铟铌钽钒等战略品种规模极小 | Figure 23: Many strategically important critical minerals remain relatively small export markets — Source: UNCTAD, Macquarie Macro Strategy（Macquarie, p13） 一句话总结： 关键矿产是"小美元、大影响"——对生产国（如澳大利亚）是战略筹码而非宏观支柱；对美国，直接进口依赖虽降，但供应链"去中国化"的真实进展远小于数据表面，冶炼瓶颈短期无解。 reports.ftext: Desk Strategy - Economics 18 November 2026 This communication has been prepared by personnel from Macquarie Sales and Trading and/or the Group Economics Department and is not a product of the Macquarie Research Department. For important disclosures relating to this communication, please see: www.macquarie.com/ salesandtradingdisclaimer. Critical Minerals The US and China: a narrow but important dependency Since we published our note late last year, critical minerals have become increasingly important to industrial policy, trade negotiations and national security. However, despite their strategic significance and growing demand, many critical minerals markets remain relatively small in economic terms. • Based on the broad UNCTAD classification, global critical minerals trade has increased strongly over recent decades, reaching $2.2 tn in 2024. • However, nearly 80% of that total is accounted for by six minerals (gold, iron ore & steel, copper, aluminium, metallurgical coal and diamonds), several of which are not on major countries' critical minerals lists. • Minerals essential to defence, semiconductors, batteries and other advanced technologies generally remain small export markets by value. Þ Global rare-earth exports, for example, were around $2 bn in 2024, while "other metals" (which includes gallium, germanium, indium, niobium, tantalum and vanadium) exports were around $3.3 bn. Recent trade patterns highlight the potential and limits of diversification. • US imports of critical minerals rose from $67 bn in 2024 to $81 bn in 2025. However, imports from China fell from $2.0 bn to $1.1 bn, with China relinquishing its position as the primary source for several minerals. Þ These estimates are based on the US critical minerals list and exclude a range of finished products containing critical minerals. • While that suggests a material reduction in reliance on China, more than half of the US's rare-earth imports (totalling $211 mn), and a significant share of several other minerals, still came from China. • Moreover, in some cases, imports have shifted towards other countries that retain significant Chinese ownership, suggesting broader supply- chain dependence may have fallen by less than direct imports imply. Australia is likely to benefit from diversification efforts given its substantial resource endowment and growing project pipeline, although the macroeconomic opportunity should not be overstated. • While investment is likely to continue expanding mining and refining capacity, critical minerals are unlikely to rival the economic importance of Australia's major commodity exports in the foreseeable future. Þ Australian critical minerals exports are expected to remain below 1% of GDP, compared to ~2% for LNG and ~4% for iron ore. • Australia's opportunity is likely to be primarily strategic, supporting national security and allied supply-chain diversification efforts. Note: To the extent Macquarie Research is referenced, it is identified as such and the associated disclaimers are included in the published research report. Please refer to the important disclosures www.macquarie.com/salesandtradingdisclaimer. 1 Critical Minerals Introduction Following the release of the revised US critical minerals list last year, we published Critical Minerals – US imports from China: small $, big impact. That note examined why critical minerals had become an increasingly important economic, industrial and geopolitical issue globally, with a particular focus on the US. At a high level, the key conclusions were: • Critical minerals punch well above their weight economically: While many critical minerals markets are relatively small, they support significantly larger industries, making them increasingly important to both economic and national security. • Critical minerals security depends on more than access to resources: Access to raw mineral resources does not necessarily translate into secure supply, particularly where refining, processing and manufacturing capacity are concentrated elsewhere. • Diversifying supply chains is likely to create strategic opportunities rather than transformative economic ones: Expanding refining capacity outside existing hubs will improve resilience, but the economic benefits for alternative suppliers are likely to be relatively modest unless prices move dramatically higher. Since we published that note, these issues have remained in focus against the backdrop of export restrictions, trade tensions and broader geopolitical conflict. Governments have stepped up efforts to secure supply, diversify value chains and reduce reliance on concentrated sources of production and processing. Meanwhile, demand for many critical minerals continues to grow. In this note, we revisit the critical minerals landscape in light of these developments. For more commodity-level detail, see Macquarie Research’s monthly Critical Minerals Chronicle. Figure 1 - While many critical minerals markets are relatively small, they support significantly larger industries, making them increasingly important to both economic and national security Source: Nassar et al. (2025), USGS, Macquarie Macro Strategy 18 November 2026 2 Critical Minerals Figure 2 - Access to raw mineral resources does not necessarily translate into secure supply if downstream supply chains are heavily concentrated Source: IEA (2025), Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 3 - Diversifying supply chains is likely to create strategic opportunities rather than transformative economic ones Source: ABS, UN Comtrade, USGS, WA Department of Mines, Petroleum & Exploration, Macquarie Macro Strategy Critical minerals matter for more than the energy transition… Critical minerals are often associated with the energy transition, but their applications are far broader. Many are essential inputs into semiconductors, digital infrastructure, aerospace, defence, healthcare, agriculture and chemical processing. See USGS (2026) and IEA (2026) for more detail. • For example, less than 20% of nickel demand globally relates to energy technologies (primarily electric vehicles and low- emissions power). • Towards the other end of the spectrum, almost 75% of lithium demand is driven by electric vehicles and grid battery storage. Figure 4 - Critical minerals’ applications extend well beyond the energy transition Source: USGS (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy …with demand growth currently supported by multiple structural trends The diversity of these end uses means demand for many critical minerals is currently being supported by multiple structural trends. While energy-transition technologies remain an important source of growth, demand is being reinforced by broader industrial policy objectives, efforts to strengthen domestic manufacturing capability, and investment in strategically important industries. 18 November 2026 3 Critical Minerals Figure 5 - Critical minerals are often associated with the energy transition, but their applications are far broader Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 6 - Demand for many critical minerals is growing strongly, driven by both the energy transition and countries pursuing other objectives Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy That is expected to drive strong critical minerals growth going forward Demand for many critical minerals is expected to grow strongly over the coming decades. Among the major critical minerals, lithium is generally expected to record the strongest demand growth, reflecting its central role in battery technologies. • As outlined in our recent Commodities Compendium, we expect global primary demand for lithium to almost double between 2025 and 2030, driven almost exclusively by electric vehicles and grid battery storage. Graphite, nickel and magnet REEs are also projected to experience substantial increases in demand. By contrast, demand growth for copper and cobalt is expected to be more moderate. • To provide a broad sense of scale, we expect global primary nickel consumption to increase by around 35% between 2025 and 2030, and for global copper demand to rise by around 15% over the same period. • Looking further out, the IEA’s projections paint a similar relative picture, with strong growth through 2040. They also demonstrate that demand projections are highly sensitive to assumptions regarding technology deployment and policy settings. Figure 7 - We expect global primary demand for lithium to almost double between 2025 and 2030, driven largely by electric vehicles and grid storage Source: Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 8 - Demand for selected critical minerals is expected to increase significantly through to 2040, albeit with a wide uncertainty range Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy 18 November 2026 4 Critical Minerals Supply is expanding, aided by government policy… Growing demand and rising geopolitical tensions have supported investment across critical mineral supply chains. New mining and processing projects have been developed in several regions, including Australia, while governments have introduced policies designed to encourage domestic production and reduce reliance on concentrated sources of supply. • For example, Australia’s recently updated Critical Minerals Strategy places greater emphasis on national security, economic resilience, and capturing more value from domestic resources through expanded processing, refining and downstream development. For many critical minerals, supply continued the rapid expansion evident in recent years (see here for longer-term context regarding a range of minerals). Indeed, despite strong demand growth, refined product supply growth generally outpaced demand growth, except for cobalt (where refined supply declined in 2025, reflecting both the significant oversupply accumulated during 2023-24 and the export ban implemented by the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in 2025). Figure 9 - The Australian Government plans to scale its presence across critical minerals supply chains, including processing and refining Source: Australian Government, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 10 - Despite strong demand growth, refined product supply growth generally outpaced demand growth, except for cobalt Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy …but concentration remains high, with refining a key bottleneck… However, much of the new refined supply in recent years has come from the largest producer, in many cases resulting in an increase in concentration. For example, refined product concentration rose between 2023 and 2025 for copper, lithium and nickel, and remained elevated (~95%) for graphite. Over the same period, concentration declined for refined cobalt and magnet REEs. • China remains the dominant refining hub for all of these minerals, except nickel. On the mining front, trends in concentration have been slightly more encouraging. For example, concentration eased somewhat for REEs as new projects have entered production in a broader range of countries. Mining concentration has also fallen for lithium and graphite, as new diversified projects have entered production in Latin America and Africa. 18 November 2026 5 Critical Minerals Figure 11 - Critical minerals refined product supply has generally become more concentrated, while mining concentration has seen mixed outcomes Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy …and that situation is not expected to materially improve going forward Looking ahead, currently announced projects are unlikely to fundamentally change the concentration profile of most critical minerals supply chains. • The IEA produces a base case for key minerals supply based on the pipeline of operating and announced mining and refining projects, accounting for the likelihood of projections reaching operations (incorporating status of financing, permitting and feasibility studies). • Their analysis suggests that mining concentration is likely to decline between now and 2040 for most minerals. However, while the diversification of supply is encouraging, especially regarding single-country exposure for cobalt and graphite, concentration remains elevated, particularly among the top three producers. • The outlook for refining diversification is more mixed. Several key minerals are expected to see an increase in concentration among the top producer and/or top three producers (copper, nickel and cobalt), while others are likely to experience a decrease (lithium, graphite and magnet REEs). • Diversification of refining and processing has proven challenging because these activities typically require significant scale, technical expertise and established downstream supply chains, creating substantial barriers to entry for new producers. In China's case, decades of investment across mining, refining, manufacturing and logistics have created integrated supply- chain ecosystems that are difficult and costly to replicate elsewhere. Much more therefore needs to be done to improve supply-chain resilience and reduce countries' exposure to critical minerals supply disruptions. 18 November 2026 6 Critical Minerals Figure 12 - While efforts are ongoing to diversify supply, much more needs to be done to improve supply- chain resilience Source: IEA (2026), Macquarie Macro Strategy The US remains heavily dependent on critical minerals imports… Given the generally slow-moving nature of mineral production and consumption, the US remained heavily dependent on imports for many critical minerals in 2025, with import dependency increasing across a number of commodities relative to 2024. • Based on the classification outlined in our previous note, we estimate that the US was 100% net import reliant for 13 out of 60 critical minerals, up from 12 in 2024 (with the addition of titanium). • The US was more than 50% net import reliant for a further 34 critical minerals (including 14 lanthanides grouped under REEs), up from 32 in 2024, with copper, palladium and silicon joining this category, while titanium became 100% net import reliant. • The US was less than 50% net import reliant for a further six critical minerals (down from nine in 2024), while remaining a net exporter of three (beryllium, boron and metallurgical coal). Insufficient production information was available to determine import dependency for the remaining four (hafnium, iridium, rhodium and ruthenium). 18 November 2026 7 Critical Minerals Figure 13 - The US was more than 50% net import reliant for at least 47 critical minerals in 2025, up from at least 44 in 2024 Source: EIA, USGS, Macquarie Macro Strategy …with that dependence increasing last year US critical minerals imports also increased significantly in 2025 relative to 2024, largely reflecting higher imports of a handful of key commodities. • Our estimates suggest that critical minerals imports totalled around $81 billion in 2025, up from $67 billion in 2024 (based on revised import figures). See our previous note for methodological detail. • The five largest contributors to US critical minerals imports – copper, aluminium, PGMs, silver and uranium – accounted for ~$58 billion worth of imports, or more than 70% of the total. Þ Copper imports were the largest, rising from $11½ billion to almost $19 billion, largely reflecting front-loading ahead of anticipated copper tariffs, which boosted both import volumes and prices. Þ While often receiving significant attention, US imports of REEs amounted to just $211 million in 2025, up from $175 million in 2024. • The increase between 2024 and 2025 was primarily driven by copper, PGMs and silver. While small in absolute dollar value, imports of rhenium, tellurium and antimony also increased substantially in percentage terms. 18 November 2026 8 Critical Minerals Figure 14 - US critical minerals imports increased to ~$81bn in 2025, up from ~$67bn in 2024, driven primarily by copper, PGMs and silver Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy The US reduced its direct reliance on China in 2025… China accounted for just $1.1 billion of US critical minerals imports in 2025 (1.4% of the total), down from $2.0 billion (2.9% of the total) in 2024. • That ranked China as the US’s 16th largest critical minerals import source by value, representing a decline from 8th in 2024. • By comparison, imports of critical minerals in 2025 totalled $20 billion (~24%) from Canada, $9.4 billion (~12%) from Chile, $7.3 billion (~9%) from Mexico, $6.3 billion (~8%) from South Africa, and $3.4 billion (~4%) from South Korea. • This largely reflects the composition of US critical minerals imports, with Canada the dominant supplier of aluminium, Chile of copper and Mexico of silver, three of the US's largest imported critical minerals by value. …with China relinquishing its position as the US’s primary import source for several minerals… That decline in imports from China was broad-based and accompanied by a significant reduction in the US’s direct import reliance on China for several critical minerals. • US imports from China fell for all but eight critical minerals in 2025, with uranium (-$205 million), graphite (-$185 million) and antimony (-$124 million) the biggest contributors to the decline. Zirconium was the only critical mineral that saw a non-trivial increase (+$20 million). • China’s share of US imports also declined considerably across most critical minerals, with China relinquishing its position as the US’s primary import source for several minerals. Þ We estimate that, in 2025, China was the US’s primary import source for only REEs (which includes 16 individual minerals), tantalum and tungsten. Even among these minerals, China’s share of US imports declined relative to 2024. Þ In 2025, China lost its position as the primary source for US imports of graphite, antimony, cesium, indium and bismuth, with most of these minerals having been affected by Chinese export restrictions introduced between 2023 and 2025. 18 November 2026 9 Critical Minerals Figure 15 - China accounted for just $1.1 bn of US critical minerals imports in 2025 (1.4% of the total), down from $2.0 bn (2.9%) in 2024 Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 16 - The US's top critical minerals import sources are often the leading suppliers of its largest imported commodities Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 17 - US imports from China fell for all but eight critical minerals in 2025 Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 18 - China’s share of US imports also declined considerably across most critical minerals Source: EIA, USGS, USITC, Macquarie Macro Strategy …although that should be interpreted with caution However, the decline in direct import reliance on China does not necessarily indicate a commensurate reduction in US dependence on Chinese supply chains. In some cases, particularly graphite and antimony, imports appear to have shifted towards other countries that retain significant Chinese commercial involvement in mining, processing, refining or trading activities. As a result, broader supply-chain dependence on China likely declined by less than direct import dependence. 18 November 2026 10 Critical Minerals Australia remains well positioned, but the economic opportunity is limited In our previous note, we analysed the role Australia could play as alternative supply chains develop and governments seek to reduce dependence on China for critical minerals. We concluded that Australia will likely play an increasing role in critical minerals supply chains, benefitting strategically and diplomatically from its mineral endowment, but that the export opportunity is relatively small in dollar terms. Our conclusions remain unchanged one year on. • Updated data from the Australian Government shows that critical minerals exports amounted to ~A$16½ billion in the 2025-26 financial year, equivalent to ~0.55% of GDP. That compares to export earnings of ~A$55 billion (1.9% of GDP) for LNG and A$119 billion (4.1% of GDP) for iron ore. • Australian exports of critical minerals are expected to increase in the coming years as new mining and refining projects enter production (especially of REEs, lithium and antimony). Nevertheless, export earnings are currently projected to reach a peak of A$26 billion over the next four years, remaining below 1% of GDP, albeit with considerable uncertainty given the potential variability in commodity prices. Figure 19 - Critical minerals exports were A$16½ bn in 2025-26 (~0.55% of GDP), compared to ~A$55 bn (1.9%) for LNG and A$119 bn (4.1%) for iron ore Source: ABS, Department of Industry, Science & Resources, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 20 - While critical minerals exports are expected to rise in coming years, they are projected to remain below 1% of GDP Source: ABS, Department of Industry, Science & Resources, Macquarie Macro Strategy Global critical minerals trade emphasises the distinction between strategic importance and economic scale To place the critical minerals opportunity in broader context, it is useful to consider the scale and composition of global critical minerals trade. Given there is no internationally agreed critical minerals list, UNCTAD has developed a classification for analytical purposes based on a consolidation of critical minerals lists published by national governments and international organisations. • The classification includes 60 minerals, grouped according to whether they are essential inputs for energy transition technologies (“required for the transition”), play a supporting role (“relevant for the transition”) or are predominantly used for other purposes (“other critical minerals”). • By construction, this classification is broader than individual countries' critical minerals lists. For example, it includes gold, iron ore/steel and diamonds, none of which are included in the critical minerals lists of Australia, the EU or the US. Based on the UNCTAD classification, global critical minerals exports have increased substantially over the past two decades, with growth broad-based across both regions and product groups. • Critical minerals exports rose from around $0.4 trillion in 2002 (1.1% of global GDP) to more than $2.2 trillion (2.0% of global GDP) in recent years. • However, much of the increase occurred during the China commodity boom in the early 2000s, with price the main driver. It is notable that as a share of GDP exports are still around the level seen 19 years ago. • While the timing of the increase varies, all regions and product groups experienced increases over that same period, even when scaled relative to global GDP. • Nevertheless, critical minerals exports remain geographically concentrated. Asia and Europe account for the largest share of exports across many mineral categories, reflecting both mineral endowments and the concentration of downstream processing and manufacturing capacity. 18 November 2026 11 Critical Minerals Figure 21 - Critical minerals exports rose from around $0.4 tn in 2002 (1.1% of global GDP) to more than $2.2 tn (2.0%) in recent years Source: IMF, UNCTAD, Macrobond, Macquarie Macro Strategy Figure 22 - All regions and product groups experienced increases over that same period, even when scaled relative to global GDP Source: IMF, UNCTAD, Macrobond, Macquarie Macro Strategy While large in aggregate, critical minerals export values are highly concentrated in a relatively small number of mineral markets. Many minerals that have attracted significant policy attention due to their strategic importance remain comparatively small export markets by value, despite their critical role in industrial, technology and energy-transition supply chains. • For example, the six largest export markets by value (gold, iron ore & steel, copper, aluminium, metallurgical coal and diamonds) together account for almost 80% (~$1.8 trillion) of total global critical minerals trade by value. • By comparison, global exports of REEs amounted to just $2.1 billion in 2024, while "other metals" (which includes gallium, germanium, indium, niobium, tantalum and vanadium) exports were around $3.3 billion. As a result, strategic importance and economic scale do not necessarily move together. Critical minerals can be strategically important for producer economies such as Australia without generating export earnings comparable to major commodity exports such as iron ore, coal or LNG, or to the largest critical mineral markets such as gold, copper and aluminium. 18 November 2026 12 Critical Minerals Figure 23 - Many strategically important critical minerals remain relatively small export markets Source: UNCTAD, Macquarie Macro Strategy 18 November 2026 13 Critical Minerals Contacts and disclaimer Ric Deverell +61 2 8232 4307 ric.deverell@macquarie.com Macquarie Group Services Australia Pty Limited Hayden Skilling, CFA +61 451 001 626 hayden.skilling@macquarie.com Macquarie Securities (Australia) Limited Anita Chao +61 437 917 571 anita.chao@macquarie.com Macquarie Group Services Australia Pty Limited Disclaimer This publication represents the views of the Sales and Trading Global Macro Strategy Department and/or Sales and Trading Desk strategists and/or Group Economics Department (collectively referred to as "Global Macro") of Macquarie. China Commodities Weekly（Desk Strategy – Metals & Bulks） · 报告日期 2026-11-23 · AI 中文精读 · 观点归属 Macquarie 本页为 AI 生成之中文精读摘要，仅供研究参考，不构成投资建议；数据与观点以英文原文为准。 目录 Contents 核心观点 Key takeaways 宏观与房地产总览 Overview 铁矿石 Iron ore 钢材 Steel 炼焦煤与焦炭 Coking coal & coke 动力煤 Thermal coal 铜 Copper 铝 Aluminium 锌 Zinc 铅 Lead 镍 Nickel 锂 Lithium 成品油 Refined oil products 物流 Logistics Section 00 · 核心观点 一句话：金属全面回撤，成本坍塌利润修复，需求端未见实质起色 宏观（Macro）： Macquarie 经济学家指出投资者对华情绪已"彻底转负（outright negative）"；只有当出口无法再独力拉动增长时，政策层才会加码内需支持——因此上周的科技股抛售对 2027 年中国经济前景 尤为关键。 黑色（Bulk & steel）： 铁矿石跌至 四年新低 （现货 -1.8% WoW），铁水产量 -0.3% 且预期继续下滑；板材需求因去库加快略有改善，长材随施工放缓走软；煤+矿成本坍塌令钢厂利润环比改善；焦煤延续跌势，市场开始炒作 第四轮焦炭提降 ；QHD 5500 动力煤 -19 元至 1,001 元/吨 ，冷空气仅带来短暂日耗脉冲。 有色（Base metals）： 铜回撤加速——LME -9.2%、SHFE -12.1%，驱动为 2027 年精炼铜过剩预期扩大、AI 情绪降温、美 232 关税近期风险下降与美联储加息押注升温；铝 LME -6.2% 但在岸持续去库、现货升水坚挺；锌进口 TC 降至 -173.6 $/t、在岸库存降 10.6kt 至 166.1kt；铅在岸库存因进口到货加快小幅累库；镍（LME -3.4%）进一步回撤；碳酸锂期货小幅走低。 原油（Crude & products）： 主营与独立炼厂开工率齐升（非国营 +1.3% WoW）——茶壶炼厂手持高成本原油库存、且预期成品油价格继续下行，因此 加快开工以消化高价桶 ；汽油与柴油库存双双增加。 Section 01 宏观与房地产总览 Overview: property sales & land market 周报宏观板块以三张地产高频图开场：30 城新房销售（10 日均值） 环比回落 ，14 城二手房销售自近期高位回落，百城土地成交则在年末呈现 翘尾上行 。宏观判断的核心结论是：市场对中国的情绪已极度悲观，而政策刺激的时点取决于出口动能何时衰减——上周全球科技股抛售因此被视为观察 2027 年中国外需风险的重要信号。 图 1 · 14 城二手房销售（10 日均值）自高位回落 | Second-hand home sales in 14 cities - 10DMA — Source: WIND, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p4） 图 2 · 百城土地成交（3 周均值）年末趋升 | Weekly 100-city land sales (3WMA) — Source: WIND, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p4） 要点： 地产销售仍弱、土地成交年末上翘，"出口依赖 + 政策后手"的组合意味着内需刺激短期内难现，商品需求故事仍偏防御。 Section 02 铁矿石 Iron ore: price fell to four-year low on falling demand 价格与供应 Price & supply 铁矿石现货价 -1.8% WoW，跌至 四年低位 （61% Fe CIF 北方，图示约 $95/t 一线）；65% Fe 高品溢价 -1.0% WoW。 澳巴发货量 +7.9% WoW，发运回升叠加需求走弱共同压制价格。 需求与库存 Demand & inventories 日均铁水产量 -0.3% WoW，且钢厂预期 进一步减产 ；247 钢厂日耗 -0.5%。 47 港口库存 -0.9% WoW；贸易商库存 -1.1%、港口内钢厂资源 -0.5%；247 钢厂厂内库存 +1.7%（主动补库意愿有限）。 盈利钢厂比例 -0.5% WoW；长流程废钢日耗 +0.4%；49 家独立电炉开工率 +1.1%。 图 3 · 61% 铁精粉 CIF 北方价格跌至四年低位 | 61% Fe fines cfr N.China ($/t) — Source: Platts, Mysteel, Thurlestone, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p5） 图 4 · 47 港铁矿石库存周降 0.9% | Iron ore port stocks, 47 ports (Mt) — Source: Platts, Mysteel, Thurlestone, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p5） 图 5 · 日均铁水产量周降 0.3%，预期继续下滑 | Daily hot metal output, Mt — Source: Platts, Mysteel, Fubao, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p6） 结论： 供需双弱但需求端（铁水）下行更快，价格创四年新低；煤、矿成本坍塌暂时改善钢厂利润，但盈利面仍在收窄。 Section 03 钢材 Steel: flats improve on destocking, longs soften 板材（Flats）需求改善 去库加快带动板材需求回暖：板材表观消费 +1.7% WoW；钢厂板材库存 -1.8%、贸易商板材库存 -1.5%；板材产量 +0.2%。 长材（Longs）随施工放缓走弱 长材表观消费 -4.6% WoW；产量 +1.5% 放大供需矛盾：钢厂长材库存 +3.1%、贸易商库存 -1.8%（贸易环节已在主动去库）。 唐山方坯库存 +2.9%；周度钢材出口发运 -7.6%；建材成交（5 日均值）持续低于去年同期。 受益于煤、矿成本下跌， 螺纹与热卷即期利润环比改善 （图示均自深亏区收窄）。 图 6 · 贸易商板材库存周降 1.5%，去库加快 | Traders' flat steel inventories, Mt — Source: Mysteel, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p7） 图 7 · 螺纹/热卷即期冶炼利润随成本坍塌改善 | Physical steel blast furnace spot margin, RMB/t — Source: Mysteel, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p8） 结论： 板材强、长材弱的分化延续；利润修复来自成本端而非需求端，若铁水继续下行，矿石与双焦仍将承压。 Section 04 炼焦煤与焦炭 Coking coal & coke: 4th round of coke price cuts in play 炼焦煤（Coking coal） 国内现货炼焦煤 -1.8% WoW，随铁水下行需求走弱；进口倒挂窗口仍开（国内价 > 进口价）。 矿山精煤库存 +5.0% WoW（累库明显）；进口焦煤港口库存 +0.8%；钢厂焦煤库存 -0.4%。 国内洗精煤产量 +0.2% WoW（523 矿口径），供应改善有限； 蒙古总统辞职后蒙煤供应波动加大 。 焦炭（Coke） 市场对 第四轮焦炭提降 的预期升温；焦化厂库存 -3.9%、钢厂焦炭库存 +0.1%。 焦化利润随焦价下跌继续回落（图示在 -200 至 +100 元/吨宽幅区间）。 图 8 · 国内炼焦煤与焦炭价格延续跌势 | Domestic coking coal and coke, RMB/t — Source: Sxcoal, Mysteel, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p9） 图 9 · 全国平均焦化利润随焦价回落 | Average coke making margins, China domestic, RMB/t — Source: Mysteel, Macquarie Strategy（Macquarie China Commodities Weekly, 2026-11-23, p10） 结论： 焦煤供需两端均弱、矿山累库，价格趋势性下行；焦炭提降博弈是下周主要看点。 Section 05 动力煤 Thermal coal: QHD fell to Rmb 1,001/t despite cold snap QHD 5500 动力煤 -19 元至 1,001 元/吨 ；部分矿区深跌后销售略有好转。 reports.stext: 能源储备：人民已发声——他们要更多柴油（Macquarie 精读） MACQUARIE · 能源 · DESK STRATEGY 能源储备：人民已发声——他们要更多柴油 The Energy Reserve — The People Have Spoken And They Want More Diesel 来源： Macquarie Global Macro Strategy（销售与交易 Desk Strategy，非研究部产品） · 2026 年 11 月 12 日 · Walt Chancellor / Peter Taylor / Emily Manalang / Xinyi Ye · 10 页 · AI 中文精读 · 观点归属 Macquarie，仅供研究参考 目录 CONTENTS 核心观点 Key Points 战争与和平，还是都不是 War and Peace or None of the Above 过境与磨难：霍尔木兹与中东石油流 Transits and Tribulations 中馏分（柴油）市场仍是焦点 Distillate Markets Remain in Focus "人民已发声"：各国政策响应与柴油贸易流 Policy Response & Trade Flows 美国炼厂保持进攻姿态 US Refiners Remain on the Front Foot 收率切换是成品油再平衡的关键 Yield Shifting Key to Rebalance KEY POINTS 核心观点 地缘降温叙事增强但仍谨慎 ：中期选举后特朗普持续淡化与伊朗迫近升级的风险、幕后外交持续涌动；与我们的"非战非和"基准一致，但未见突破迹象。若美伊核问题分歧显著收窄，油气市场将走向更快正常化，地缘尾部风险将更对称。 霍尔木兹油流韧性依旧 ：10 月经霍尔木兹原油+清洁成品油流出近 12 MBD ，最近一周（截至 11/5）约 13 MBD ；同期经富查伊拉/红海略低于 6 MBD；沙特 10 月产量 10.6 MBD 已高于战前（2025/11–2026/01）水平。 库存回补 ：截至 10/30 的四周全球石油累库超过 1 MBD （或低估在途石油增幅）。 柴油仍是焦点 ：法国开始释放 10 MM BBL 战略柴油储备的首批（约 1/3）；11/10 抛售令 ICE gasoil 近月收于 8 月末以来最低；但全球馏分油基本面仍紧（低库存+冲突减产）。 政策端全力保供 ：韩国 10/29 将柴油出口上限由上年同月的 100% 放宽至 110% ；俄罗斯装运回升但月度进度落后承诺；印度 10 月气柴油出口创季节新高（环比 +100+ KBD ）；中国出口自 9 月 450+ KBD 高点回落——国内柴油库存同比 -17% 、原油加工量同比 -1.3 MBD 才是核心约束。 美国炼厂进攻性十足 ：Q4 至今美国原油加工量同比 +1 MBD 以上；Valero 收购 LyondellBasell 休斯顿炼厂（目标 2027 年底重启）、Chevron 推进 Pascagoula 扩能并以专有催化剂提高馏分油收率。 收率切换是再平衡关键 ：2020 年 4 月美国柴油收率曾从 30.9% 提至 39.8% 、航煤从 10.5% 降至 4.8% ；本轮伊朗战争期间 3–6 月 OECD 航煤收率同比 +1.5pp （欧洲 +2.5pp ）；当前重心已从航煤转向整体中馏分，且可能需延续至 2027 年 。成品油再平衡将滞后于原油。 Section 01 战争与和平，还是都不是 War and Peace or None of the Above 美国中期选举后，特朗普继续淡化与伊朗迫近升级的可能性，同时媒体陆续报道幕后外交活动。这一鸽派转向在宏观上与我们当前的冲突观点一致——但 尚未看到外交突破即将到来的迹象 。能源市场对特朗普的一言一行高度敏感，其近期表态令人们对副总统 Vance 主导的直接谈判重启产生疑虑。 若美伊在核问题上的分歧显著收窄，冲突达成持久外交解决的前景将自然改善。这对能源市场的影响将是深远的：为当前"非战非和"的中间态（我们基准情形的定义）提供一条通向油气更快正常化的清晰路径。 立场： 鉴于近年美伊外交线上无数次"假动作"与"未遂开局"，我们对此次外交突破前景仍保持谨慎；但这一潜在推动会让地缘与能源的尾部风险变得更对称一些。 Section 02 过境与磨难：霍尔木兹与中东石油流 Transits and Tribulations 虽是老生常谈，但中东石油流出、尤其是经霍尔木兹海峡（SoH）的流量依然强劲： 10 月经 SoH 的原油+清洁成品油流出 近 12 MBD ，另有略低于 6 MBD 经富查伊拉/红海——高于我们认为稳定全球石油平衡所需的水平。 截至 10/30 的四周，全球石油库存累增超过 1 MBD ，且该数字可能还低估了"在途石油"的增加。 最近一周（截至 11/5）霍尔木兹流量尤为强劲，约 13 MBD 。 沙特报告 10 月产量 10.6 MBD ，高于战前（2025/11–2026/01）水平——从 9 月东西管道（East-West）中断中显著恢复。 市场对霍尔木兹这一脆弱平衡与危险状态的不适可以理解；但面对伊朗持续袭击航运，油流韧性与商业风险偏好已被充分确立。从博弈论视角看， 任何一方单方面背离当前均衡（急剧升级）的即时风险并不明显 ——双方更多是在当前战略矩阵内演进战术：伊朗扩大打击目标、调整攻击投送方式并尝试其它干扰航行的手段；美国则努力把封锁扩展到陆上/里海路线。 Fig 1 · 霍尔木兹过境与警报频率（7 日移动均线）：原油+成品油流出回升，而袭击频率同步抬升 | Figure 1 - SoH Transits Improve Alongside Elevated Attack Frequency — Source: MSCIO, UKMTO, Kpler, Vortexa, Windward, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 Fig 2 · 沙特西海岸+富查伊拉装载量（14 日移动均线，KBD）：管道改道回落但仍高出 1–2 月均值逾 2 MBD | Figure 2 - Pipeline Reroutes Fall But Remain Over 2 MBD Above January-February Average — Source: Kpler, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 Fig 3 · 全球石油库存变动（4 周移动，MBD，原油数据至 11/6、成品油至 10/30）：近期商业原油重回累库 | Figure 3 - Global Oil Stock Changes — Source: EIA, S&P Global, METI, Kayrros, Kpler, Macquarie Macro Strategy, October 2026 Section 03 中馏分（柴油）市场仍是焦点 Distillate Markets Remain in Focus 近期 ICE gasoil 价格随上述"去升级化"冲动回落；法国开始释放其 10 MM BBL 战略柴油储备计划的首批（约三分之一），进一步压制价格。11 月 10 日的抛售令近月合约收于 8 月下旬以来最低结算价。 但全球馏分油基本面仍然偏紧：库存低位叠加冲突相关减产。同时近几个月柴油贸易流已出现明显改善——中东、俄罗斯与亚洲出口增加，美国炼厂在检修季表现突出。往前看，我们预计收率切换（详见第 06 节）将在石油综合体再平衡过程中对中馏分基本面产生更持久的影响。 节奏判断： 成品油市场的再平衡之路虽然最终可以走通，但将 滞后于原油的恢复 。短期内馏分油（尤其柴油）仍受胡塞与乌克兰袭击、北半球冬季来临等一篮子风险的左右。 Section 04 "人民已发声"：各国政策响应与柴油贸易流 Policy Response and Global Diesel Trade Flows 中期选举中生活成本问题分量很重——这是对"总统必须把美国 pump price 压低、否则面临政治风险"的又一次提醒。我们认为这一幕将长期影响美国能源政策（其净出口国地位还在扩张）。特朗普临选举前的柴油价格干预虽未明显挽救选情，但 9–10 月围绕柴油的政策活动近期开始结果： 法国 ：开始释放 10 MM BBL 战略储备承诺的首批，以缓解零售燃料价格。 俄罗斯 ：柴油装运量上升，最初发往美国的货物已转向；在《结束进口俄罗斯石油法案》（Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act）约束下，未来货物预计也将走类似路径。不过月内（MTD）总装运仍落后于承诺的 11 月节奏。 韩国 ：10 月 29 日应国内炼厂请求放宽柴油出口限制——出口上限从上年同月装运量的 100% 提高到 110% ，前提是满足国内供应承诺并维持充足库存。 中国 ：柴油出口自 9 月近两年高点（ 450+ KBD ）回落，国内供应紧张才是约束——尽管 11 月初追加的成品油（CPP）出口配额为年内出口留足空间。上周中国柴油库存同比 -17% ，炼厂尚未明显提负（原油加工量同比仍 -1.3 MBD ）。预计近期油价回落有助于修复国内炼油利润、支持开工回升；待旺季供应压力缓解、国内供应恢复后，中国柴油出口存在上行潜力。 印度 ：10 月气柴油出口创季节新高（环比 +100+ KBD ），11 月以来保持高位。支撑因素：炼厂开工强劲、中东原油进口增加、美国→欧洲经济性转弱令需求转向印度资源、柴油出口税较 9 月下调。但 11–12 月国内旺季需求或限制出口进一步增长。 Fig 4 · 全球水运柴油装载量（上：绝对值 MBD；下：同比 MBD）：同比缺口已回补并转正 | Figure 4 - Global Waterborne Diesel Supply Closes YoY Deficit — Source: Vortexa, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 Section 05 美国炼厂保持进攻姿态 US Refiners Remain on the Front Foot 三季度财报季中，炼厂与石油巨头无一例外地强调馏分油生产。近几周美国炼厂表现令人印象深刻： Q4 至今美国原油加工量同比上升超 1 MBD 。炼厂不仅压着检修窗口提负，还在多个时间维度上主动应对产品紧张：Valero 宣布收购 LyondellBasell 休斯顿炼厂（目标 2027 年底 重启），Chevron 强调 Pascagoula 的长期扩能，并披露使用自有催化剂提升馏分油收率。 不过，美国炼厂在"转产柴油"上的收率切换仍然有限——近期周度数据的上升很大程度上只是在跟踪历史季节性漂移。 Section 06 收率切换是成品油再平衡的关键 Continued Prioritization of Middle Distillate Yields 今年馏分油动荡的主线是供应下降→价格上涨→需求破坏。但往前看，收率切换有望为市场提供更不显眼的缓解。在严重短缺状态下，收率切换只是"打地鼠"游戏——牺牲一种产品换另一种；但在更平衡的油市中，收率切换能对成品油的正常化发挥建设性作用。 历史参照：2020 年的极限切换 2020 年航煤与汽油需求崩塌促使炼厂转向柴油，美国尤甚： 2020 年 4 月美国柴油收率升至 39.8%（一年前 30.9%），航煤收率从 10.5% 降至 4.8% ；同月 OECD 柴油收率同比 +5.4pp、航煤 -4.5pp。虽是极端例子，但说明炼厂有能力根据市场失衡大幅调整产品收率。 本轮伊朗战争中的切换 冲突初期航煤是首要矛盾：战前约 27% 的全球水运航煤出口经霍尔木兹，其中 63% 通常流向欧洲（约占该地区水运航煤进口的 40% ）。在航煤相对利润走强的驱动下，3–6 月 OECD 炼厂航煤收率同比平均 +1.5pp ，其中欧洲 +2.5pp ——这一收率优化对冲了中东供应损失的关键部分。 随着市场演变，柴油成为主要矛盾：炼厂从"最大化航煤"转向"最大化整体中馏分"，柴油与航煤收率以牺牲汽油、石脑油等轻质产品为代价得到优先保障，部分缓解了中馏分紧张。考虑到航煤需求的相对韧性，这一模式可能需要 延续到 2027 年 ，才能走完成品油全面正常化的长路。 Fig 5 · 2020 年美国产品收率同比变化：4 月柴油 +8.7pp、航煤 -5.7pp，切换幅度空前 | Figure 5 - US Shifts from Jet to Diesel in 2020 — Source: IEA, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 Fig 6 · OECD 中馏分（柴油+航煤）收率 2026 年显著高于 2022–2025 年（上），收率同比变化显示柴油+航煤挤压轻馏分（下） | Figure 6 - OECD Refiners Favor Middle Distillates Over Light Distillates — Source: IEA, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 Fig 7 · OECD 欧洲中馏分收率抬升以对冲中东进口损失：3–6 月航煤收率同比 +2.5pp | Figure 7 - OECD Europe Refiners Focus on Maximizing Middle Distillates to Offset Loss of Middle East Imports — Source: IEA, Macquarie Macro Strategy, November 2026 一句话总结： 霍尔木兹油流与炼厂收率切换的双重韧性，正在把"非战非和"的油市推向缓慢再平衡；柴油是最后一公里，也是 2027 年前持续的主战场。
